card.text: 55 Cnc f was found in 2007 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "55 Cancri Af"
sources.quote: 55 Cancri Af, also designated Rho1 Cancri f and formally named Harriot, is an exoplanet approximately 41 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Cancer.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc; its size is a model. Its tilt is not measured: it is drawn in the plane measured for 55 Cnc d.

sources.quote: 55 Cancri Af is the fourth-known planet from the star 55 Cancri A and the first planet to have been given the designation of "f".
